deviations.what: No native finger swipe in WebKit: Playwright 1.64.1 WebKit has tap() only. Driven instead (a) in real WebKit with the iPhone 13 profile as a right-to-left page.mouse pointer drag, and (b) as a trusted touchStart/touchMove/touchEnd sequence through CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent in Chromium with the iPhone 13 profile.
deviations.why: The preview handles pointer events and sets touch-action none; both facets reach that handler, and the CDP facet is real touch input.

deviations.what: Зберегти у файл and Відкрити файл ran through the app fallback (anchor download and <input type=file>), not the Chromium File System Access pickers, which are browser chrome; an init script removed showSaveFilePicker, showOpenFilePicker and showDirectoryPicker.
deviations.why: Both picker and fallback paths carry the same bytes through serializeLayout and parseLayout in src/storage/layoutFile.ts; the checked behaviour is downstream of the file read and write.
